geography_policy: U.S.-first; global and Thailand are separate packages after U.S. measurement stability

waves.name: containment_and_version_lock
waves.exit_gate: Blueprint/spec/artifact hashes and ontology align; stale global artifacts are superseded.

waves.name: systematic_literature_review
waves.exit_gate: Search, screening, appraisal, contrary evidence, and exact locators complete by claim family.

waves.name: claim_map_ontology_formula_and_blueprint_rewrite
waves.exit_gate: Retain/rewrite/quarantine/transfer decisions and units agree across Book and Topic.

waves.name: source_vintage_and_canonical_data
waves.exit_gate: Provider identity, terms, release, vintage, hash, units, and coverage close by lane.

waves.name: artifact_integrity_and_global_repair
waves.exit_gate: Complete-case global panel, metrics, bootstrap, dependency hashes, and downstream counts reconcile.

waves.name: production_and_resource_transformation
waves.exit_gate: KLEMS/I-O baseline and physical-footprint sensitivity complete.

waves.name: money_value_and_payment_behavior
waves.exit_gate: Purchasing power, exchange value, payment use, and store-of-value results remain separate.

waves.name: money_credit_fiscal_and_cantillon
waves.exit_gate: Identified shocks, exposure, pre-trends, placebo, and negative controls complete.

waves.name: payer_financing_and_lineage
waves.exit_gate: Sources-and-uses and observed/inferred/modelled/unobserved boundaries are explicit.

waves.name: knowledge_infrastructure_and_innovation
waves.exit_gate: Independent proxy families and project/capital evaluation pass.

waves.name: wages_welfare_market_power_and_time
waves.exit_gate: Construction, distribution, firm-size, concentration, and time-use lanes are source-locked.

waves.name: energy_exergy_and_natural_capital
waves.exit_gate: Heat content, throughput, efficiency, exergy, EROI, emissions, and depletion remain distinct.

waves.name: historical_and_intellectual_history
waves.exit_gate: Specialist review and evidence tiers close or claims remain quarantined.

waves.name: global_and_thailand_packages
waves.exit_gate: 30+ economy complete common panel and rights-reviewed Thailand package complete.

waves.name: causal_synthesis_external_replication_publication
waves.exit_gate: Two independent designs per causal claim, independent rerun, human review, and publication package.

evaluation_policy.primary_panel: United States annual 1959-2024; frozen baseline retained until a new version is declared
evaluation_policy.metric_contract: RMSE, MAE, and median absolute error remain distinct
evaluation_policy.bootstrap: random moving blocks with replacement; seed, block size, and draws recorded
evaluation_policy.multiple_testing: adjust within each predeclared claim family

promotion_policy: Evidence Grade A is evaluated by claim/lane first. No average may hide a controlling WARN/BLOCKED gate.
prohibited_interpretations: observed transaction lineage without tagged evidence
